title: Satisfiability for fan-in-two circuits
statement: Let $C$ be a finite acyclic Boolean circuit. Suppose each gate has no repeated input vertices, and every negation gate has exactly one input vertex; suppose also that every gate has at most two input vertices. Then $C$ has an input assignment for which its output is true if and only if the CNF formula associated with $C$ has a satisfying assignment.
hypotheses_covered: C is a DAG circuit with n input vertices
each gate's argument list has no repetitions
every negation gate has exactly one argument
every gate has at most two arguments
